# Site for sale

> Lovely 0.5 acre/0.2 hectare site available to buy subject to planning permission. The site occupies a slightly elevated site with an east-west orientation. The property is conveniently located 5-km to Kilmacow village, 4.5 km to Ferrybank and 5km to Waterford City and is also within close proximity of Strangmills National School. Services: Main water available
